notes: Tesla publishes no state, country or regional breakdown of employees, stores, service centers or Supercharger sites in its FY2024 10-K or Q4 2024 Update; both give only global totals (e.g. 6,975 Supercharger stations and 65,495 connectors at end-2024, Q4 2024 Update), so countries and regions are null. The one state figure is California (36,700 Tesla employees in 2021) from an IHS Markit study Tesla commissioned and hosts; it is three years older than the snapshot. Tesla also hosts a 'Gigafactory Nevada Economic and Fiscal Impact Analysis 2022' (Applied Analysis), but its headcounts combine Tesla with on-site vendors (Panasonic and others) and direct, indirect and induced jobs, so no Tesla-only Nevada figure is recorded. Sites are the eight primary manufacturing facilities in 10-K Item 2 plus the Austin headquarters; vehicle-factory capacity figures come from the Q4 2024 Update table (installed capacity, not production). Gigafactory Shanghai and Megafactory Shanghai: Tesla owns the buildings and holds 50-year land use rights. Period: Dec 31, 2024. [Editor] The single California row (36,700 employees, 2021, IHS Markit study commissioned by Tesla) is omitted: one state cannot make a state map and the figure predates the snapshot.
